Brave's independent web index: web, news, images, videos, places, LLM context and answers.

## API key

- **Get your key here:** [api-dashboard.search.brave.com](https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/app/keys)
- **Setting:** `BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY`
- **API reference:** [api-dashboard.search.brave.com](https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/documentation)

### Get the key

1. Sign in to Brave Search and open [api-dashboard.search.brave.com](https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/app/keys).
2. Create an API key (or token) with only the access your apps need.
3. Copy it. Many providers show a key only once.

**What to create:** Activate a plan (it includes $5 of free credit a month), then create a key under API Keys; the Gateway sends it in the X-Subscription-Token header. Searches are GETs (POST works too); answers are a POST to /res/v1/chat/completions.

Steps for this provider are brief. [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Brave%20Search) to request a full guide.

### Set it on your Gateway

From your EveryApp folder:

```bash
pnpm everyapp secret set BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY
```

It asks for the value at a hidden prompt, and it's live at once, with no deploy. If an app you've installed needs it, `pnpm everyapp configure <app>` asks for it along with everything else the app needs.

### Use it in an app

List it in the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  "brave-search": { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

`access` is `"read"`. The app calls the provider's own URLs with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

### Check it worked

- `pnpm everyapp provider show brave-search` shows the key as set and which apps use it.
- `pnpm everyapp status` shows apps that were waiting for it as ready.

### Cost and limits

- **Cost:** Search $5 per 1k requests; Answers $4 per 1k plus $5 per million tokens; $5 free credit a month; only successful calls count.
- **Rate limits:** 50 calls a second. Search plan 50 queries per second; Answers 2 per second.
